components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a screen: start workout, save, finish.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent, #f0824c); color: var(--accent-ink, #1d0f07); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,250,245,0.16), 0 1px 2px rgba(8,6,4,0.4); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #f59362); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); background: var(--accent-press, #e2733e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0824c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as adding a set or cancelling.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-surface, #1a1917); color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,244,230,0.11)); border-top-color: var(--border-top, rgba(255,248,240,0.11)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(8,6,4,0.4); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-inset, #23211e); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0824c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed field for names and other text.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--bg-inset, #23211e); color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(255,244,230,0.07)); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary, #918b81); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border, rgba(255,244,230,0.11)); } .ds-input:focus-visible, .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #f0824c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(240,130,76,0.11)); }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,244,230,0.11)); color: var(--text-secondary, #aca69d); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(240,130,76,0.11)); border-color: var(--accent, #f0824c); color: var(--accent, #f0824c); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0824c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default container for workouts, stats and reports.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; background: var(--bg-surface, #1a1917); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(255,244,230,0.07)); border-top-color: var(--border-top, rgba(255,248,240,0.11)); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(8,6,4,0.4); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(8,6,4,0.35), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(8,6,4,0.55); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-meta { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-tertiary, #918b81); }

components.name: Set Row
components.description: Signature: one set with index, previous value, reps, kg and the done check.
components.html: 18 × 80
components.css: .ds-set { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0,1fr) 72px 72px 44px; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 4px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bg-surface, #1a1917); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-set.is-done { background-image: linear-gradient(var(--accent-soft, rgba(240,130,76,0.11)), var(--accent-soft, rgba(240,130,76,0.11))); } .ds-set-idx { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-align: center; color: var(--text-tertiary, #918b81); } .ds-set.is-done .ds-set-idx { color: var(--accent, #f0824c); } .ds-set-prev { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text-tertiary, #918b81); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-num { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0; text-align: center; background: var(--bg-inset, #23211e); color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; outline: none; } .ds-set.is-done .ds-num:not(:focus) { background: transparent; } .ds-num:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #f0824c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(240,130,76,0.11)); } .ds-check { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255,244,230,0.11)); background: none; color: var(--text-tertiary, #918b81); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-check:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); } .ds-check:active { transform: scale(0.92); } .ds-set.is-done .ds-check { background: var(--accent, #f0824c); border-color: var(--accent, #f0824c); color: var(--accent-ink, #1d0f07); } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0824c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Phone navigation: three tabs on frosted glass, active icon in ember.
components.html: TrainingFortschrittEinstellungen
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); height: 64px; padding: 8px; background: rgba(18,17,16,0.8); border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(255,244,230,0.07)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(16px); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(16px); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-tertiary, #918b81); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text-primary, #f3f0ea); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] svg { color: var(--accent, #f0824c); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f0824c); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The app is a quiet strength gym at night. Cast-iron surfaces in warm graphite, chalk-white type, and a single ember glow wherever something needs a lifter's attention: the action to take, a finished set, a new record. Nothing is decorative. The atmosphere comes from warmth in the neutrals (every grey leans brown, never blue), from fine light catching the top edges of plates, and from numbers set in tabular figures so weights and reps line up like a logbook.

Density is calm on review screens and compact where logging happens. The workout screen is built for 90 seconds of rest and sweaty hands: 44px touch targets everywhere, big numeric fields, one ember tick per completed set. Interaction is tactile and confident: buttons press down, checkmarks pop with a small spring, sheets rise from below. Every response is felt but brief.

Dark is the home theme; light mode is the same gym by daylight, with chalk paper and a deeper, rust-like ember. The system follows the OS setting, with a manual override.
keyCharacteristics: Warm graphite neutrals, never cool grey.
One accent (ember orange), used for action, completion and records.
Geist for words, Geist Mono and tabular figures for every number that matters.
Hairline borders with a lighter top edge instead of heavy shadows.
Tactile press feedback (scale 0.92–0.99) on everything tappable.
Mobile-first: bottom tab bar and docks on phones, sidebar from 960px.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember is the only saturated color in the interface. If something new needs emphasis, it gets ember or nothing; never introduce a second accent hue.

rules.name: The Warm Grey Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries a hint of brown (RGB tints like 255/244/230 and 48/32/16). A cool or pure grey is a bug.

rules.name: The Earned Glow Rule
rules.body: Ember marks what the lifter should do next or what they just achieved. Decorative ember (borders, dividers, background art) is not allowed.

rules.name: The Aligned Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every weight, rep count, duration and comparison uses tabular figures. Columns of numbers must never shift width as values change.

rules.name: The Quiet Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for 12px tracked labels in tertiary color. Never uppercase headings or buttons.

rules.name: The Top-Edge Rule
rules.body: Raised surfaces get a slightly lighter top border (--border-top / --border-strong) instead of a heavier shadow.

rules.name: The Float Means Temporary Rule
rules.body: Only transient layers (sheet, toast, timer) use the Float shadow. Permanent content never floats.

dos: Do take every color, size, radius and duration from the CSS tokens at the top of `index.html`. Components never hard-code values.
Do keep every tappable element at least 44px (use an invisible hit area if the visual must be smaller).
Do use tabular figures for every number and Geist Mono for ticking values.
Do give every tappable element press feedback (scale 0.92–0.99, 150ms, ease-out `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`).
Do define both themes for any new color: dark default, light under `prefers-color-scheme: light` and `[data-theme="light"]`.
Do pair every status color with its soft wash rather than using it as a solid fill.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or use ember decoratively.
Don't use cool or pure greys anywhere.
Don't use Float shadows on permanent content.
Don't set uppercase anything except 12px tracked labels.
Don't let the spring easing (`cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)`) leak beyond small confirmation moments like the set check.
Don't make input text smaller than 16px (iOS zooms on focus).
